Sizes are in pixels. Letters and numbers use the Latin font, and Japanese text uses the Japanese font. Text that does not fit is shortened with “…” so that it does not overlap.

Drag the right edge, bottom edge or bottom-right corner of the figure to resize it. Saved images keep the shape and size shown on screen.
“Both” writes the percent and count on two lines. Labels are omitted where the slice is too small.
“Both” writes labels like “45.0% (9)”. On a count axis, it is “9 (45.0%)”. Labels that do not fit are omitted automatically.
